description: Two independent bipolar stepper motors (inner and outer shaft) packaged concentrically in one part.
how_to_use: A1+/A1-/B1+/B1- are the outer shaft motor's two coils, A2+/A2-/B2+/B2- are the inner shaft motor's two coils — each pair needs its own driver (e.g. two A4988s), same as a plain stepper-motor.
